annotation.title_clean: Human-Robot Ethical Collaboration Through Adaptive Business Processes
annotation.title_en: Human-Robot Ethical Collaboration Through Adaptive Business Processes
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Janjua, S.H.; Shahid, H.; Pettinari, S.; Filippone, G.; de Sanctis, M.; Inverardi, P.
annotation.venue: Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence and Applications, Vol. 423: HHAI 2026 (IOS Press)
annotation.summary_en: HHAI 2026 paper proposing a methodology that uses LLMs as planning components to make robot business processes ethics-aware and adaptive to runtime context, user needs and moral preferences. Demonstrated by a proof of concept in an assistive care scenario on a real robotic platform.
key_provisions_or_claims: Static one-size-fits-all workflows cannot handle evolving ethical preferences and runtime contexts.
Proposes LLMs as planners to make business processes ethical-aware.
Proof of concept on a real assistive care robot platform.
LLMs given structured patient profiles generate personalized, context-sensitive action sequences.
